name: Jinquan Fengtu Ji
source:
On a sultry summer night, our main character caught up in a peculiar event and he then embarked on a summer trip in a small town called [Jinquan City].

In the game, you will encounter beastman characters with different personalities, experience the local customs, participate in various activities, and your character may enjoy an unforgettable relationship with their beloved one.

[Translated from [url=https://kemono.games/zh-Hans/game/Diary-of-summer-travel]Kemono Games[/url]]
